blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Token merging has emerged as an effective training-free strategy for accelerating diffusion models by reducing redundant token computation while minimizing generation degradation. A key challenge is determining which tokens can be safely merged and which should be preserved for subsequent computation. Existing method addresses this by preserving prompt-aligned foreground regions, thereby protecting semantically relevant structures. However, this text-relevance criterion overlooks background objects, local details that are not explicitly mentioned in the prompt, leading to degraded structural coherence. In this work, we propose Dynamics-aware Token Merging (DaTMe), a training-free framework that grounds token merging in the underlying diffusion dynamics. Our key insight is that token importance should reflect whether a token remains unresolved during denoising and whether it carries structural information. To this end, DaTMe constructs a dynamics- aware importance map from the Tweedie denoised estimate. The map combines a temporal signal, measuring inter-step changes in the predicted clean image, with a structural signal, capturing local high-frequency content such as boundaries and fine details. Using this map, DaTMe adaptively assigns tokens into merging roles under a given compression ratio: important tokens are preserved as anchors, while tokens that are both temporally stabilized and structurally homogeneous are selected as safe merge candidates. Experiments on PixArt-a and FLUX demonstrate that DaTMe maintains visual fidelity across the entire image, highlighting diffusion dynamics as an effective token-level merging decision in efficient generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/SeungJuCha/DaTMe.
blocks.zh: Token合并已经成为一种有效的无培训战略,通过减少冗余符号计算并尽量减少生成退化来加快传播模式。 一个关键的挑战是如何确定哪些信使可以安全地合并,哪些信使应当保留,以便随后进行计算。 现有方法通过保护迅速相通的前景区域来解决这一问题,从而保护具有高度相关性的结构。 然而,这一文本相关标准忽略了背景对象,即当下未明确提及的地方细节,导致结构一致性退化. 在这项工作中,我们提出“动态认识”合并(DaTMe),这是一个无培训框架,它使基本的传播动态具有象征意义。 我们的主要见解是,象征性的重要性应反映一个象征是否在发号施令期间仍未解决,以及它是否载有结构信息。 为此,DaTMe从Tweedie去声化的估计中构建出一张动态——意识到重要性的地图. 地图将时间信号结合起来,测量所预测的清洁图像的相继变化,并带有结构信号,捕捉出边界等局部高频内容和细微细节. 使用此地图,DaTMe在给定的压缩比下适应性地将指使符指定为合并角色:重要指使被保留为锚地,而同时在时间上稳定并结构上均匀的指使被选为安全的合并候选人. 在PixArt-a和FLUX上的实验表明,DaTMe在整个图像中保持视觉忠心,强调扩散动态是高效生成中有效的符号级合并决定. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/SeungJucha/DaTMe上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Diffusion models [ 34 , 29 ] have become a dominant paradigm for high-quality image [ 30 , 8 , 4 ] and video synthesis [ 20 , 17 , 31 ] , owing to their strong fidelity and scalability.
However, their iterative denoising process incurs substantial computational cost, as a large number of tokens are repeatedly processed at every inference step [ 43 ] .
To address this, token merging [ 2 ] has emerged as an effective training-free acceleration strategy that groups similar tokens, merges them into representative tokens, and uses the merged representations in subsequent layers [ 43 , 2 , 46 , 24 , 9 ] .
For example, early token merging methods such as ToMeSD [ 2 ] first construct local merge candidate groups in a content-agnostic manner, and then form merge pairs simply based on feature similarity within each group.
Consequently, content-relevant tokens can be selected as merge sources, causing local details to be absorbed and leading to visual distortion [ 43 ] .
This raises a central challenge: which tokens should be absorbed through merging , and which must be retained as anchors for subsequent computation.
blocks.zh:
传播模式[34,29]因其强烈的忠诚和可伸缩性,已成为高质量图像[30,8,4]和视频合成[20,17,31]的主导范式.
然而,它们的迭代解密过程需要大量的计算成本,因为大量的代号在每一个推论步骤[43]中都会反复处理.
为了解决这一问题,象征性合并[2]已经成为一种有效的无培训加速战略,将类似的符号分组,合并成具有代表性的符号,并在随后的层次使用合并的表示[43、2、46、24、9]。
例如,早期的符号合并方法如ToMeSD[2]首先以内容不可知的方式构建本地合并候选组,然后简单地根据每个组内的特征相似性形成合并对.
因此,内容相关的符号可以被选为合并源,导致本地细节被吸收并导致视觉扭曲[43].
这提出了一个中心挑战:哪些信物应通过合并吸收,哪些信物必须保留作为随后计算的基础。

blocks.en:
Prior work [ 43 ] leverages classifier-free guidance (CFG) [ 12 ] as a token importance signal, identifying tokens strongly steered by the text condition through the discrepancy between conditional and unconditional noise predictions as anchors to be retained.
However, as shown in Fig. 1 (a), CFG-based
merging tends to underprotect non-prompt regions of the image, losing
fine details and structural coherence.
We attribute this to CFG’s prompt-centric bias: by
focusing exclusively on text-conditioned influence, CFG overlooks two key aspects of how diffusion models generate images.

然而,如图1(a)所示,以CFG为基础
合并往往对图像的非瞬间区域保护不足,丢失
详细细节和结构一致性。
我们将此归因于CFG的即时偏差:
CFG只注重文字条件的影响,忽略了传播模型如何生成图像的两个关键方面.

blocks.en:
First, CFG fails to capture time-varying token importance .
Diffusion generation follows a coarse-to-fine progression [ 10 , 13 ] ,
where tokens undergoing large inter-step changes represent regions in which the model is actively injecting details [ 3 ] .
In this context, prematurely merging such still-evolving tokens directly attenuates their ongoing refinement by averaging their features with neighboring tokens.
Crucially, the spatial distribution of these actively evolving tokens is time-varying: while it remains concentrated on foreground objects in early steps, it progressively expands toward broader spatial regions, including non-prompt areas, at later timesteps (Fig. 1 (b)).
High-ranked tokens in CFG importance signal, however, remain anchored to foreground objects throughout the entire timestep, confining its search for important tokens only to prompt-aligned regions.
As a result, CFG fails to identify the very tokens that should be protected: actively evolving tokens outside the foreground are prematurely merged into nearby or similar tokens, suppressing their distinct updates.
blocks.zh:
首先,CFG未能捕捉时间变化的象征重要性。
扩散的一代遵循粗细进化[10,13],
表示该模型正在积极注入细节的区域。
在这种情况下,过早地将这种仍在演变中的象征物合并起来,直接削弱了它们目前不断的完善,因为它们的特征与邻近的象征物相平均。
关键的是,这些正在积极演变的标志物的空间分布是时差不一的:虽然它在早期阶段仍然集中在前方物体上,但在后期逐渐向更广泛的空间区域,包括非瞬间区域扩展(图1(b))。
然而,CFG重要信号中排名高的标志在整个时间段一直固定在前方物体上,将其寻找重要标志的工作仅限于迅速结盟的区域。
因此,CFG未能识别应保护的象征物:在前景之外积极演化的象征物过早地合并为附近或类似的象征物,压制了它们独特的更新.

Figure 1: (a) Comparison under different compression ratios. CFG-based merging [ 43 ] often overlooks background details and structures, whereas our method better preserves background integrity. (b) Spatial distribution of top-ranked tokens over denoising timesteps. CFG-based importance remains concentrated on the foreground object with limited temporal variation.
In contrast, our score-based signals (Score Slope and Tweedie Diff) progressively shift from object regions to fine-grained spatial details, better matching the pseudo-GT pattern.

blocks.en:
Second, CFG is insensitive to prompt-independent structural importance .
To produce natural and coherent images, diffusion models actively generate scene elements that are not directly mentioned in the prompt such as background objects and supporting structures [ 34 , 29 ] .
Although these prompt-independent structures contribute little to text guidance, they carry essential structural information such as boundaries between homogeneous regions, edges of background objects, and fine textures that anchor visual coherence.
However, because CFG only measures text-conditioned discrepancy, structural boundaries in such non-prompt regions tend to receive low scores across all timesteps (Fig. 1 (c)), making them vulnerable to merging into neighboring homogeneous areas.
Taken together, these observations indicate that token importance should not be defined solely by text relevance, but by diffusion dynamics: how unresolved a token remains and how much structural information it carries at the current denoising step [ 48 ] .
blocks.zh:
第二,CFG对迅速独立的结构重要性不敏感。
为了产生自然和连贯的图像,传播模型积极生成在提示中未直接提及的场景元素,如背景对象和支持结构[34,29].
虽然这些迅速独立的结构对文本指导作用不大,但它们载有基本的结构信息,如同质区域之间的界限、背景物体的边缘以及支撑视觉一致性的精细纹理。
然而,由于CFG只衡量文本条件差异,这种非瞬间区域的结构界限往往在各个阶段都得到较低的分数(图1(c)),使它们容易合并到邻近的同质地区。
总而言之,这些意见表明,象征性的重要性不应仅由文本的相关性来界定,而应由传播动态来界定:一个符号的未解决程度如何,以及在目前的去名步骤下它携带了多少结构信息[48]。

blocks.en:
To faithfully capture diffusion dynamics, we define two
complementary signals that quantify the spatiotemporal dynamics
of each token during denoising.
For temporal dynamics, we start from the score function [ 41 ] ,
which quantifies how each token is updated at the current denoising step.
In particular, we project this score into clean-image space via the Tweedie
denoised estimate [ 33 , 7 ] ,
and use its inter-step difference as the temporal signal , assigning high values to tokens that are unresolved.
Unlike CFG, this score-derived signal reflects the actual update applied to every token, regardless of prompt relevance, providing an image-wide view of generative activity (Fig. 1 (b)).
For the structural signal , we measure the residual
between the Tweedie estimate and its coarse-scale smoothed version, which acts as a high-pass filter highlighting structural components throughout the image.
This captures prompt-independent structural boundaries, including weakly conditioned structures that CFG often underestimates.
By jointly modeling temporal evolution and structural saliency, we obtain a dynamics-aware token importance signal that guides merging decisions.

blocks.en:
Building on this dynamics-aware importance, we propose D ynamics- a ware T oken Me rging (DaTMe) , a training-free token merging framework for diffusion transformers [ 29 , 4 , 19 ] .
At each denoising step, DaTMe assigns token roles at the intersection of the temporal and structural signals.
High-scoring tokens are assigned as constraint tokens and excluded from merging as dynamically or structurally important regions, while low-scoring tokens are assigned as source tokens from relatively stable and homogeneous regions that can be safely merged.
To meet the target compression budget, DaTMe supplements the source set with grid-based spatial sampling, preventing local collapse.
The resulting source tokens are then merged only within nearby regions via locality-constrained matching, built upon [ 43 ] .
We primarily evaluate DaTMe on PixArt- α \alpha and FLUX, where it outperforms prior methods while maintaining visual fidelity across the entire image.
Our contributions are as follows: • We introduce a dynamics-aware importance map derived from the Tweedie estimate, jointly capturing the temporal evolution and structural saliency of each token. • We propose DaTMe , a training-free token merging framework that leverages the proposed temporal and spatial importance signals to identify safely mergeable tokens while preserving structurally critical regions. • We validate DaTMe on DiT (PixArt- α \alpha ) and MM-DiT (FLUX), showing strong preservation of image-wide details and state-of-the-art performance across most metrics.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
Token Reduction in Large Models. Token reduction is a widely used strategy for improving Transformer efficiency, mainly through token pruning or token merging [ 2 , 32 , 5 , 45 , 47 ] .
Representative methods such as ToMe [ 1 ] use training-free bipartite matching, while later approaches refine token selection using attention or frequency-domain cues [ 45 , 47 ] .
However, most of these methods target single-forward-pass architectures with relatively static token importance.
Diffusion models, by contrast, update token representations over many steps, motivating diffusion-specific approaches such as ToMeSD [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh:
大型模型中的托肯减值。 托肯减量是一种广泛采用的提高变形器效率的战略,主要通过象征性的挤压或象征性的合并[2,32,5,45,47].
ToMe [1] 等代表方法使用无培训双人配对,而后来的方法则使用注意或频率域提示来完善符号选择[45,47].
然而,这些方法大多针对具有相对静态象征重要性的单向前传架构.
相比之下,传播模式在许多步骤上更新了象征性表述,激发了如 ToMeSD [2] 等针对传播的方法。

blocks.en:
Token Merging in Diffusion Models. A wide range of methods have been proposed to accelerate diffusion models, including improved samplers [ 26 , 37 , 28 , 39 , 40 ] and weight quantization [ 21 , 38 ] . However, such approaches often require additional training or optimization, introducing non-trivial overhead.
Training-free methods instead reduce the number of tokens processed during inference through pruning [ 48 , 15 ] , caching [ 27 , 42 , 23 ] , or merging [ 43 , 2 , 46 , 24 , 9 ] .
Among them, ToMeSD [ 2 ] extends token merging in ViTs [ 1 ] to diffusion models by grouping tokens based on feature similarity.
Several subsequent methods [ 24 , 9 ] leverage cross-attention maps to identify important tokens from semantically or structurally salient regions, aiming not merely to reduce computation but also to preserve informative representations during token reduction [ 18 ] .
More recently, [ 43 ] uses classifier-free guidance (CFG) as a saliency signal without additional attention computation, but because CFG primarily reflects alignment with the conditioning signal, it fails to capture the spatially heterogeneous and temporally evolving dynamics of the full image.
In contrast, our method leverages the Tweedie denoised estimate to construct a dynamics-aware importance map that captures both temporal evolution and spatial structure across the image.
blocks.zh:
Token 合并在扩散模型中。 为加速传播模型提出了广泛的方法,包括改进的取样器[26、37、28、39、40]和重量量化[21、38]。 然而,这类方法往往需要额外的培训或优化,引入非部落间接费用。
免费培训方法则减少在推论期间通过挤压[48、15]、挤压[27、42、23]或合并[43、2、46、24、9]处理的代币数量。
其中,ToMeSD[2]在ViTs[1]中扩展符号合并,通过基于特征相似性的组合符号向扩散模型扩展.
随后的几种方法[24,9]利用交叉注意的地图,从成形或结构突出的区域找出重要的标志,其目的不仅是减少计算,而且还要在减少标志性表示时保持信息性表述[18]。
最近,[43]将无线导引(CFG)作为显要信号,无需额外注意计算,但由于CFG主要反映了与调制信号的对齐,因此无法捕捉到全图像的空间多样性和时间演变的动态.
相比之下,我们的方法利用了Tweedie去声化的估计,构建出一个动态感知重要性的地图,该地图可以捕捉整个图像的时间进化和空间结构.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Our goal is to design a token merging strategy for efficient image generation by accounting for diffusion dynamics.
To this end, we first define a dynamics-aware importance signal that characterizes token importance from two complementary perspectives: temporal dynamics and structural saliency .
Based on this importance map, we assign tokens into functional roles for merging, distinguishing safe merge sources and structurally important constraint tokens.
We then perform locality-constrained token merging, together with grid-based source completion to satisfy the target compression ratio.
In the following, we first motivate our Tweedie-based spatiotemporal importance signals (Sec. 3.2 ), and then describe how they are used in our proposed DaTMe framework (Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是为高效的图像生成设计一种象征性的合并战略,通过核算传播动态。
为此,我们首先从两个互补角度界定了具有动态意识的重要信号,从时间动态和结构优势这两个角度来描述象征性的重要性。
根据这份重要地图,我们为合并、区分安全合并源和结构上重要的制约标志的功能角色分配了标志。
然后,我们进行局部限制的符号合并,加上基于网格的源完成,以满足目标压缩率。

Theoretical Comparison of Temporal Signals. To characterize token-level evolution during denoising, we compare two temporal signals derived from the score function [ 41 ] : the raw score slope, | s ⁡ ( t ) − s ⁡ ( t − 1 ) | |s(t)-s(t-1)| , and the Tweedie difference, | x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) − x ^ 0 ​ ( t − 1 ) | |\hat{x}_{0}(t)-\hat{x}_{0}(t-1)| .
As derived in Appendix A , the score slope can be decomposed into two components: s ⁡ ( t ) − s ⁡ ( t − 1 ) = ϵ θ ​ ( t − 1 ) − ϵ θ ​ ( t ) σ t − 1 ⏟ difference term + ϵ θ ​ ( t ) ​ ( 1 σ t − 1 − 1 σ t ) ⏟ scale term . s(t)-s({t-1})=\underbrace{\frac{\epsilon_{\theta}(t-1)-\epsilon_{\theta}(t)}{\sigma_{t-1}}}_{\text{difference term}}+\underbrace{\epsilon_{\theta}(t)\left(\frac{1}{\sigma_{t-1}}-\frac{1}{\sigma_{t}}\right)}_{\text{scale term}}. (5) The first term reflects changes in the model prediction across timesteps and is therefore associated with actual token-level evolution.
In contrast, the second term arises purely from the predefined global noise schedule σ t \sigma_{t} rather than changes in the model prediction itself.
As denoising approaches the late steps ( σ t → 0 \sigma_{t}\to 0 ), the inverse difference | 1 σ t − 1 − 1 σ t | \left|\frac{1}{\sigma_{t-1}}-\frac{1}{\sigma_{t}}\right| grows rapidly.
This suggests that the scale term can increasingly dominate the score slope in later stages, making the resulting signal less reliable.
To obtain a cleaner temporal measure, we instead project the score into predicted clean-image space via the Tweedie estimate x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) \hat{x}_{0}(t) [ 36 ] and consider its inter-step residual, x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) − x ^ 0 ​ ( t − 1 ) \hat{x}_{0}(t)-\hat{x}_{0}(t-1) .
By algebraic decomposition (Appendix A ), this residual reduces to: x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) − x ^ 0 ​ ( t − 1 ) = σ t − 1 α t − 1 ​ ( ϵ θ ​ ( t − 1 ) − ϵ θ ​ ( t ) ) , \hat{x}_{0}(t)-\hat{x}_{0}(t-1)=\frac{\sigma_{t-1}}{\alpha_{t-1}}\big(\epsilon_{\theta}(t-1)-\epsilon_{\theta}(t)\big), (6) which removes the scale term that appears in the raw score slope and retains only the difference term update.
Furthermore, the update is scaled by σ t − 1 α t − 1 \frac{\sigma_{t-1}}{\alpha_{t-1}} , and this factor decreases as denoising concludes, naturally attenuating the signal in late steps.
These properties make the Tweedie difference a more stable temporal signal for measuring token evolution.
Empirical Validation of Temporal Signals. We validate the theoretical analysis above through two empirical tests: temporal autocorrelation and correlation with a pseudo-GT change measure.

We first examine temporal autocorrelation to assess whether each signal remains responsive to token-wise refinement over denoising steps (Fig. 2 (b)).
The CFG-based importance [ 43 ] exhibits consistently high autocorrelation across all timesteps, confirming its static nature and its bias toward fixed, prompt-aligned foreground regions, as previously observed in Fig. 1 (b).
In contrast, both score-based signals, namely the raw score slope and the Tweedie difference, initially show noticeably lower autocorrelation, indicating greater sensitivity to image-wide refinement than CFG.
However, temporal autocorrelation alone does not naturally imply that a signal reflects token-level convergence.

我们首先审查时间自动化关系,以评估每个信号是否仍然对象征性的改进作出反应(图2(b))。
以CFG为基础的重要性[43]在所有时间段显示出一贯高度的自动关系,证实了它的静态性质及其对固定的、迅速相通的前景区域的偏向,如图1(b)所述。
相比之下,两个基于分数的信号,即原始分数坡度和Tweedie差数,最初都明显地显示出较低的自动关系,表明对全图像改进的敏感性比CFG更高.
然而,光是时间自动化并不能自然地意味着一个信号反映了象征级的趋同.

blocks.en:
To evaluate whether a signal faithfully reflects token-level convergence, we measure its correlation with a reference signal constructed from the per-timestep Tweedie estimate x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) \hat{x}_{0}(t) , which we treat as a proxy for the clean image following [ 36 ] .
We then define the deviation between the final clean latent x 0 x_{0} and x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) \hat{x}_{0}(t) , denoted as | x 0 − x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) | |x_{0}-\hat{x}_{0}(t)| , as a pseudo-GT measure of how much each token is still expected to change.
As shown in Fig. 2 (a), the cosine similarity between x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) \hat{x}_{0}(t) and the final denoised latent steadily approaches 1.0 1.0 over time, indicating that x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) \hat{x}_{0}(t) progressively approximates the final generation state.
Moreover, when tokens are partitioned by their pseudo-GT magnitude, high-ranked tokens consistently exhibit larger changes across denoising steps than low-ranked ones, suggesting that this pseudo-GT provides a meaningful per-token reference for remaining change.

Using this pseudo-GT, a clear difference between the two score-based signals emerges (Fig. 2 (c)).
While both signals show high correlation with the pseudo-GT in the early stages, the correlation of the raw score slope drops sharply around normalized timestep 0.4 0.4 – 0.6 0.6 .
Consistent with our theoretical decomposition, this degradation closely matches the range where the scale term empirically overtakes the difference term (Fig. 3 ).
At the same time, the autocorrelation of the score slope rises (Fig. 2 (b)), indicating increasingly static behavior and reduced sensitivity to token-wise refinement.
In contrast, by removing scale term interference, the Tweedie difference maintains both a higher correlation with the pseudo-GT and a consistently lower temporal autocorrelation throughout denoising.
Taken together, these results suggest that the Tweedie difference provides a more reliable temporal signal for tracking token evolution than either the raw score slope or CFG.

To capture this structural property, we introduce a spatial axis derived from the same Tweedie estimate.
Specifically, we use the spatial axis to distinguish structurally salient but temporally stable tokens from genuinely mergeable homogeneous regions.
To this end, we define the spatial axis as the residual between x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) \hat{x}_{0}(t) and its coarse-scale approximation obtained via interpolation-based transformation [ 16 ] : ℳ s ​ p ​ a ​ t ( t ) = | x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) − UpSample × s ​ ( DownSample × s ​ ( x ^ 0 ​ ( t ) ) ) | , \mathcal{M}_{spat}^{(t)}=\left|\hat{x}_{0}(t)-\mathrm{UpSample}_{\times s}\!\Big(\mathrm{DownSample}_{\times s}\!\big(\hat{x}_{0}(t)\big)\Big)\right|, (8) where s s denotes the spatial scale used to construct the coarse approximation.
This spatial map assigns high responses to contours, boundaries, and fine textures, while giving low responses to locally homogeneous regions.
By combining the temporal and spatial axes, we obtain an importance signal that reflects both how tokens evolve over time and how much structural information they carry at each denoising step.

blocks.en:
Implementation Details and Evaluation Metrics. We primarily conduct experiments on PixArt- α \alpha [ 4 ] using 10k image-prompt pairs sampled from the COCO 2014 validation set [ 22 ] .
We set the interpolation scale to s = 4 s=4 , and for grid-based source completion, we use P = 4 P=4 grid cells.
We evaluate three compression ratios: 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7.
Following [ 43 ] , we apply DaTMe to the middle-range self-attention layers of the DiT [ 29 ] backbone.
To further evaluate scalability on a larger DiT model, we apply DaTMe to FLUX [ 19 ] .
We use FLUX.1-dev and additionally apply DaTMe from the middle block to the final block within the joint-attention blocks using the same hyperparameters.
More details are in the supplementary materials.
For evaluation, we follow prior work [ 43 , 2 , 24 , 9 ] and report CLIP-T and FID.
In addition, we report HPSv2 [ 44 ] , which complements CLIP-T by measuring preference-oriented prompt faithfulness and perceptual quality.
We also report SSIM, PSNR, and LPIPS to measure image-level fidelity and detail preservation relative to the original output.
We further report the Aesthetic score using Aesthetic Predictor V2.5, a SigLIP-based reference-free image aesthetic predictor.
All experiments are conducted on a single RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell.

blocks.en: 4.1 Main Experiments
blocks.zh: 4.1 主要实验

blocks.en:
Qualitative Results. In Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 , we compare qualitative results at a compression ratio of 0.5.
On PixArt- α \alpha , directly merging tokens based on feature similarity (ToMeSD) severely disrupts spatial structure, often leading to obvious structural distortion.
Although the CFG-based method preserves foreground structures that are explicitly described in the prompt, it shows noticeably weaker preservation in background and other weakly conditioned regions, as highlighted by the red boxes.
This qualitatively supports our analysis that CFG-based importance is strongly biased toward prompt-conditioned content and is therefore less effective at preserving the full image context.
blocks.zh:
定性结果. 在图5和图6中,我们以0.5的压缩率比较质量结果。
在PixArt-α\alpha上,基于特征相似性(ToMeSD)的直接合并令牌严重扰乱了空间结构,往往导致明显的结构扭曲.
虽然基于CFG的方法保留了在提示中明确描述的前景结构,但正如红箱所强调的那样,在背景和其他条件薄弱的区域,它明显显示保存较弱。
这在质量上支持了我们的分析,即基于CFG的重要性强烈偏向于即时条件的内容,因此在保存完整图像背景方面不太有效.

blocks.en:
On FLUX, existing methods generally preserve the coarse prompt semantics, but still introduce noticeable deviations from the original generation.
ToMeSD tends to alter the original composition, object geometry, or viewpoint, as seen in the relative arrangement of the cats, the fire hydrant structure, and the airplane viewpoint.
ToMA shows similar structural drift while additionally introducing noisy visual degradation that weakens overall image quality.
In contrast, DaTMe more faithfully preserves the original spatial configuration and object structure while maintaining the intended prompt semantics.
These results demonstrate that DaTMe reduces both structural deviation and visual degradation across different architectures.
Additional results under various compression ratios are in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
在FLUX上,现有方法一般保留粗糙的即时语义,但仍然引入了与原代的明显偏差.
ToMeSD倾向于改变原始组成,对象几何,或观点,从猫的相对排列,火体水合结构,以及飞机视角中可以看出来.
ToMA显示类似的结构漂移,同时还引入了吵闹的视觉退化,削弱了整体图像质量.
相比之下,DaTMe更忠实地保留了原来的空间配置和物体结构,同时保持了预定的即时语义.
这些结果显示,DaTMe减少了结构偏差和不同建筑的视觉退化.
在各种压缩比率下的其他结果载于附录C。

blocks.en:
Quantitative Results. In Tab. 2 and Tab. 2 , we compare DaTMe with prior methods on PixArt- α \alpha [ 4 ] under various compression ratios.
Although DaTMe is slightly slower than prior methods in terms of latency, the prior methods suffer from substantial quality degradation as the compression ratio increases, particularly in FID.
In contrast, DaTMe remains much more robust under compression, consistently preserving image quality and achieving the most favorable overall quality-efficiency trade-off.
Notably, DaTMe also attains substantially stronger structural preservation, which indicates that the proposed spatiotemporal importance signal effectively prevents structurally important tokens from being merged prematurely (Tab. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
量化结果。 在 Tab. 2 和 Tab. 2 中,我们在各种压缩比下,将 DaTMe 与 PixArt- α\alpha 上的前置方法进行比较.
虽然DaTMe在耐久性方面略慢于以前的方法,但随着压缩率的上升,特别是FID的上升,以前的方法的质量严重退化.
与此相反,在压缩下,DaTMe仍然更加强大,始终保持图像质量,实现最有利的整体质量效率权衡。
值得注意的是,DaTMe还实现了显著更强的结构保存,这表明拟议的瞬间重要性信号有效地防止了结构上重要的标志过早地被合并(第2段)。

blocks.en:
In the FLUX results, CFG-based token selection is not applicable because FLUX does not employ CFG, whereas DaTMe remains directly applicable despite the architectural difference.
Across all compression ratios, DaTMe consistently achieves the strongest CLIP-T and HPSv2 scores while maintaining comparable inference efficiency (Tab. 4 ).
Although ToMeSD preserves reasonable text–image alignment, its substantially lower SSIM and PSNR and higher LPIPS indicate larger structural deviations from the original generation.
ToMA better preserves the original structure than ToMeSD, but still exhibits noticeable visual degradation, particularly in fine details and overall image quality.
In contrast, DaTMe achieves the strongest overall image fidelity, consistently improving SSIM, PSNR, and aesthetic quality while maintaining strong prompt alignment (Tab. 4 ).
These quantitative trends are consistent with Fig. 6 , where DaTMe more faithfully preserves the original image structure.
blocks.zh:
在FLUX结果中,基于CFG的符号选择不适用,因为FLUX不使用CFG,而DaTMe尽管在建筑上存在差异,仍然直接适用.
在所有压缩比率中,DaTMe始终实现最强的CLIP-T和HPSv2分数,同时保持可比较的推论效率(第4段)。
虽然ToMeSD保留了合理的文本-图像对齐,但其大幅降低的SSIM和PSNR以及更高的LPIPS表明与原代的结构偏差较大.
ToMA比ToMeSD更好地保存了原有的结构,但仍然表现出明显的视觉退化,特别是在细微的细节和整体图像质量方面.
与此相对照,DaTMe实现了最强的整体形象忠贞,不断改进SSIM,PSNR,以及美学质量,同时保持强烈的快速对齐(第4段).
这些定量趋势与图6一致,DaTMe更忠实地保留了原始的图像结构.

blocks.en:
Importance of Temporal and Spatial Signals. In Tab. 5 , we ablate the two components of our importance map by using only the temporal axis, only the spatial axis, or both.
Using both axes yields the best overall performance, confirming that temporal evolution and structural saliency provide complementary cues for token selection, whereas either axis alone is insufficient to fully characterize mergeability.
We further replace our temporal signal with the raw score slope to evaluate its effectiveness in the actual merging process.
As shown in Tab. 5 , this substitution consistently degrades all evaluation metrics, and Fig. 7 shows that it also introduces noticeable visual artifacts.
This is consistent with our earlier analysis that the score slope becomes increasingly contaminated by schedule-driven effects in later denoising steps, making it less reliable for token merging.
blocks.zh:
时空信号的重要性。 在 Tab. 5 中,我们只使用时间轴,只使用空间轴,或两者并用,从而减轻了我们重要地图的两个组成部分.
使用这两个轴可以产生最佳的总体性能,确认时间演变和结构优势为象征性选择提供了互补的提示,而仅靠两个轴不足以充分说明合并的特性。
我们进一步用原始分数坡取代时间信号,以评估其在实际合并过程中的效力。
如图5所示,这种替代方法不断降低所有评价指标,图7显示它也引入了明显的视觉文物。
这符合我们先前的分析,即分数坡度在后来的去诺步骤中越来越受到时间表驱动效应的污染,使得对象征性合并的可靠性降低。

blocks.en:
Fig. 8 further illustrates how different importance signals affect region preservation.
The CFG-based signal [ 43 ] is strongly biased toward prompt-aligned foreground regions and therefore neglects unmentioned background content.
Using only the temporal signal alleviates this issue by preserving evolving background regions (yellow box), but it still misses structurally important boundaries (black regions), leading to structural distortions (red box).
By jointly modeling temporal and spatial signals, our importance map preserves both evolving background content and critical object boundaries, resulting in more faithful image structure and higher overall visual quality.
blocks.zh:
图8进一步说明了不同的重要性信号如何影响区域保护。
基于CFG的信号[43]强烈偏向于快速对接的前景区域,因此忽略了未提及的背景内容.
仅仅使用时间信号通过保留不断演变的背景区域(黄盒)来缓解这一问题,但它仍然错过了结构上重要的边界(黑盒区域),导致结构扭曲(红盒).
通过共同建模时间和空间信号,我们的重要地图既保留了不断演变的背景内容,也保存了关键的物体边界,从而产生了更加忠实的图像结构,提高了整体视觉质量.

Constraint Token Selection. In Tab. 6 , we ablate different definitions of the constraint set.
The best results are obtained when the constraint tokens are selected from regions with both high temporal and high spatial responses.
In particular, including spatially high-response tokens improves structural preservation, indicating that the spatial axis captures fine object details and structurally salient regions.
By contrast, using spatially low-response tokens degrades performance because such tokens are biased toward homogeneous regions and therefore fail to protect meaningful object structure.

blocks.en:
Effectiveness of the Importance Signal. To isolate the contribution of our importance signal, we keep the entire merging pipeline of [ 43 ] unchanged and replace only its CFG-based importance with ours.
Since [ 43 ] requires a single token ranking, we combine our temporal and spatial rankings using rank-sum.
As shown in Tab. 7 , replacing only the CFG-based signal with ours improves CLIP-T, HPSv2, and all fidelity metrics, demonstrating that the proposed dynamics-aware importance more effectively identifies tokens to preserve or merge.
Using the full DaTMe merging strategy further improves all metrics, indicating that the role-assignment and spatial merging design provides additional complementary benefits.

由于[43]需要一个单一的符号排名,所以我们把时间和空间的排名结合使用阶次和.

Preference Study. We evaluate perceptual quality at a compression ratio of r = 0.3 r=0.3 using human judgments.
For 20 randomly sampled PixArt- α \alpha cases, 32 evaluators compare outputs from ToMeSD, CFG [ 43 ] , and DaTMe without access to the uncompressed reference.
Evaluators independently rate text alignment and visual quality, and select their overall preferred result.
As shown in Fig. 9 , DaTMe achieves the highest ratings for both text alignment and visual quality, while also being the most preferred method overall.

评价者独立评定文本对齐和视觉质量,并选择其总体首选结果.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented DaTMe , a diffusion-dynamics-aware token merging
framework for efficient image generation.
By leveraging the Tweedie denoised estimate, DaTMe defines token
importance along two complementary axes—temporal evolution and
structural saliency—that reflect the image generation process.
This allows DaTMe to identify safely mergeable tokens while
preserving structurally critical regions, achieving strong image fidelity and favorable
quality-efficiency trade-offs across DiT-based
diffusion models.
Our work shows that grounding token merging in the underlying
generation dynamics is a key step toward faithful and efficient
diffusion inference.

We further evaluate DaTMe on U-Net-based architectures, specifically Stable Diffusion 1.5 and SDXL. For these models, we set the interpolation scale to s = 2 s=2 and the number of grid cells to P = 4 P=4 . Images are generated using 50 inference steps, with a guidance scale of 7.5 for Stable Diffusion 1.5 and 5.0 for SDXL.
Following [ 43 , 2 ] , we apply token merging at the 64 × 64 64\times 64 latent resolution in both architectures.
Unlike in DiT-based models, we do not explicitly construct the constraint set 𝒮 con \mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{con}} for U-Net backbones. Because U-Net architectures already possess a strong spatial inductive bias through convolutions, tokens with similar features are naturally organized in nearby spatial regions [ 6 ] . Consequently, spatial locality is implicitly preserved. We therefore only identify the source set 𝒮 src \mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{src}} and sample the remaining merge candidates without enforcing an additional constraint set. Finally, token merging begins at the same denoising step as in the DiT experiments.

我们进一步评价基于U-Net的DaTMe架构,特别是稳定扩散1.5和SDXL. 对于这些模型,我们设定插值尺度为s=2s=2,网格细胞数为P=4P=4. 图像使用50个推论步骤生成,SDXL稳定扩散1.5和5.0的指导尺度为7.5.

与基于 DiT 的模型不同,我们没有为 U-Net 骨干明确构建约束集 S con\ mathcal{S}_{\ mathrm{con} 。 由于U-Net架构已经通过演化拥有很强的空间诱导偏差,具有类似特征的符号自然在附近的空间区域组织 [6]. 因此,空间位置被隐含地保留下来。 因此,我们只识别源代码 src \ mathcal{ S}_{\ mathrm{ src}}} , 并且对剩余的合并候选人进行抽样, 而不执行额外的约束集 。 最后,符号合并开始于与DiT实验相同的去名步骤.

blocks.en: Figure 18: Limitations. In highly complex images, aggressive compression adversely affects image quality, leading to loss of structural details and visual coherence.
blocks.zh: 图18:限制。 在高度复杂的图像中,积极的压缩对图像质量产生不利影响,导致结构细节和视觉一致性的丧失.

blocks.en:
In highly complex scenes with many objects or intricate backgrounds, excessive merging can inevitably remove necessary tokens, leading to degraded generation quality.
In addition, the layer-wise roles of diffusion models remain underexplored, especially in DiT-based architectures.
Understanding which layers contribute most to structural layout, fine details, or background refinement could further improve token merging by enabling layer-aware compression strategies.
blocks.zh:
在具有许多物体或复杂背景的高度复杂的场景中,过度的合并可能不可避免地去除必要的标志,导致生成质量的退化.
此外,扩散模型的分层作用仍然没有得到充分探讨,特别是在基于DiT的架构中.
了解哪些层最有助于结构布局、细微细节或背景的改进,可以通过使层感压缩策略进一步改善符号合并。
